events.name: Vancouver Canucks at Detroit Red Wings
Columbus Blue Jackets at Chicago Blackhawks

headlines.description: — Sean Monahan had a goal and assist, and the Columbus Blue Jackets extended their points streak to six games with a 6-3 win over the Chicago Blackhawks on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Monahan with goal and assist, Blue Jackets extend points streak to 6 with 6-3 win over Blackhawks

headlines.description: — Mason Marchment scored the winning goal on a spinning backhander with 7:37 to play with an assist from Jake Oettinger, who made 26 saves, as the Dallas Stars beat the Winnipeg Jets 3-1 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mason Marchment's spinning backhander leads Stars past Jets 3-1

headlines.description: — Troy Terry tied a career high with three assists and scored the go-ahead goal in the shootout as the Anaheim Ducks beat the Ottawa Senators 4-3 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Troy Terry ties career high with 3 assists, scores in shootout as Ducks beat Senators 4-3
